lines.t: ...When I was a child I didn't know right from wrong but I was chastised,
my mother would beat me with a branch outside,
the beatings were painful, I cried and I cried the branch made my legs swell to the point it got red,
I went in my closet for comfort instead,and cried to the lord,
was this in his plan,I felt all confused,
but as I got older, I felt the lords presence,
he said lean on my shoulder,you must learn to forgive,
and let go of the past,and break free at last,
for this wasn't my plan, for a child to get spanked,
though I said spare the rod or spoil the child,
for a child is innocent so meek and mild,
you must walk in the spirit and be made anew,
for I have plans for you ,your one of the few,
that I have chosen,so you need to obey me and do what I say,
and forgive your mother,for her you must pray,
for she too is a child in many ways,
she hasn't grown up so a child she remains,
she's your sister my daughter for she didn't know,
who her mother was,her iq was low but as she went to school,
she began to get smarter,although she was bullied,
by classmates,so cruel,she had to let go my child as she grew,
for her mother had died when she was two,
her childhood was hard, so let go of the past and forgive your dear mother and be free at last.
eyes
